name: @lng/api
description: Express API: graph persistence (MongoDB) and the only gateway to the simulation service.

scripts.build: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node20 --format=esm --outfile=dist/index.js --sourcemap --external:express --external:mongodb --external:cors --external:dotenv --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
